source.quote: As of October 26, 2026, there were 864,657,109 shares outstanding of the registrant’s Class A common stock, par value $0.0001 per share; and 6,519,005 shares outstanding of the registrant’s Class B common stock, par value $0.0001 per share.

notes: Class A is listed on the New York Stock Exchange as MA. Class B is non-voting, held only by certain customers and unlisted (2026 proxy: "Mastercard’s Class B common stock is not publicly traded or listed on any exchange or dealer quotation system"); it converts one-for-one into Class A. Counts are from the Q3 2026 10-Q cover (filed October 29, 2026), newer than the FY2025 10-K cover (February 6, 2026). Treasury shares are excluded.
